message.content:
This document describes **Project Maya**, a local LLM inference stack for running large MoE models on consumer/prosumer hardware. Key technical points:

**Quantization & Models**
- Maya quants are named by model + tier (XS/S/M/L) based on expert bit-width. Tiers trade size for fidelity vs. the FP8 original (e.g., GLM-5.3 Maya-L hits 99.2% zero-shot accuracy and 90% next-token match; Maya-S is 97.9%/83%).
- Supports GLM-5.3-Flash (Maya's own quants
